exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Present simple vs present continuous

items.prompt: We ___ the suspense account every week.
items.hintAfterError: 'Every week' indica rotina, então pede presente simples; 'we' não leva -s.

items.prompt: Right now, Emily ___ three old entries in suspense.
Today she ___ to the Brazil office about an odd inter-company entry.
Nobody ___ what this £900 entry is for.
items.hintAfterError: 'Know' é verbo de estado: não costuma ir para o contínuo.

items.prompt: Emily usually ___ the sweep on Mondays, but this week she ___ it on Wednesday.
items.hintAfterError: Hábito ('usually') pede presente simples; exceção temporária ('this week') pede presente contínuo.
